name: Lugaid Réoderg
text: Lugaid Réoderg, also written Reoderg, is a variant of the name Lugaid Riab nDerg. MacKillop 2008 treats it inside the article on that Ulster Cycle king and opens no separate notice.

attributes.attribute: variant spelling, with the form Reoderg, of the name Lugaid Riab nDerg
receives no independent notice in MacKillop 2008 beyond the cross-reference

okr.objective: Cross-references the variant name Lugaid Réoderg to its target entry, Lugaid Riab nDerg.
key_results: MacKillop 2008 records Reoderg alongside Réoderg as a variant of Lugaid Riab nDerg
The bearer is an Ulster Cycle king treated under the Riab nDerg headword
